name: fcl-vscode
description: FHiCL (.fcl) support: syntax checking, navigation, and a fhicl-dump preview of the resolved configuration, with per-window UPS/mrb environments

fhicl.diagnostics.enable.description: Show syntax errors and undefined-reference warnings as you type (built-in parser).

fhicl.fhiclFilePath.description: Extra directories searched for #include files, in addition to FHICL_FILE_PATH. Also appended to FHICL_FILE_PATH when running fhicl-dump. Supports ${workspaceFolder}. Useful in mrb development, where your source .fcl files are not on FHICL_FILE_PATH.

fhicl.validateOnSave.description: Run fhicl-dump on every save of a .fcl file. Off by default; the 'FHiCL: Validate with fhicl-dump' command always works on demand.

fhicl.commandPrefix.description: Default container wrapper for all environments (an environment can override it), one argument per entry, e.g. ["apptainer","exec","-B","/cvmfs","/path/to/image.sif"]. The workspace must be visible at the same path inside the container.

fhicl.dumpPath.description: fhicl-dump executable (default: 'fhicl-dump' on the PATH of the configured environment).

fhicl.expandPath.description: fhicl-expand executable (default: 'fhicl-expand' on the PATH of the configured environment).

fhicl.timeoutSeconds.description: Time limit for each environment capture or tool run (container start-up can be slow).

enumDescriptions: Run every tool inside the configured container/setup (slow start, always consistent).

Capture the environment once, then run tools directly on this machine with it (fast). Needs the tool's shared libraries to be reachable from the host; falls back to the container if the tool cannot start.
fhicl.runMode.description: Default run mode for all environments (an environment can override it). 'cachedHost' captures the environment once, then runs tools directly on this machine.

fhicl.extraLibraryPath.description: Default directories added to LD_LIBRARY_PATH for host runs (cachedHost), for all environments; an environment can override it.

fhicl.environments.markdownDescription: Named FHiCL environments. Each VS Code window picks one from the status bar (**FHiCL: …**), so two windows can use two different UPS/mrb setups. Fields other than `name` are optional; unset fields use the top-level `fhicl.*` defaults.

name.description: Shown in the status bar and picker; must be unique.

setupCommand.description: Shell snippet run (in bash -l) before FHiCL tools, e.g. 'source /cvmfs/.../setup_dune.sh; setup dunesw v10_26_00d05 -q e26:prof' or 'source ~/dev/localProducts_*/setup; mrbslp'.

commandPrefix.description: Overrides fhicl.commandPrefix for this environment ([] = no container).

fhiclFilePath.description: Extra #include directories for this environment, searched before fhicl.fhiclFilePath. Supports ${workspaceFolder}.

commands.title: Open Resolved Configuration Preview to the Side
Reload Environment (re-run setup for this window's environment)
